Text collisions and detached annotation: stacked pin numbers on IC ground pins (TPD6S300, TPS25751), refdes/value labels displaced from their parts (R104/R105/R106, C401/C402, C405), net label over resistor body near U101.VCC

Poor page use: large empty regions on every sheet with parts clustered in rows/corners, and support parts (C451/C452/C404/C408, R432, TP412, decoupling for U405/U402) placed away from the pins they serve
